item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic release competing models as AI price wars intensify
item.description: The rival AI labs released lower cost versions of their flagship models within hours of each other. Is it a race to the bottom?

item.title: Trump admin says it will save $2.2 billion by removing 760,000 ACA enrollees over fraud claims
item.description: Officials allege the enrollees were ineligible, fraudulently enrolled or did not exist, while another 419,000 enrollments face review.

item.title: Trump had a 'good meeting' with Iranian officials, warns he may 'annihilate the Islamic Republic'
item.description: Trump has accused Iran of "behaving badly" and stalling to make a deal to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz because the regime is "weak and desperate....

item.title: After 40 investors rejected Amazon pitch, Bezos' parents gave $245,573
item.description: Bezos' stepfather first asked about the company, "What's the internet?" the Amazon founder previously said.
